issue.description:
## Description

Replace flat world generation with simplex/perlin-noise-based hills.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Hills are gentle, not jagged (suitable for a 6-9 year old to walk over)
- [ ] Different elevations show different blocks (grass on top, dirt below, stone deeper)
- [ ] World generation is reproducible with a seed
- [ ] Performance remains smooth at 64×64

## Notes for AI

* Use `simplex-noise` library via CDN, pinned version
* Seed the noise so the same world generates each time (until reset)
* Recommended layers: stone deep down, dirt mid, grass on surface
* Max height variation: \~6-8 blocks (gentle hills, not mountains)

## Definition of done

All acceptance criteria met, file runs without console errors.
